newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore leaves corporate tax rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Singapore leaves corporate tax rate unchanged.

text.p: Singapore's corporate tax rate will remain unchanged, Finance Minister Richard Hu said on Friday.

"We reduced our corporate tax and personal income tax rates last year. The lower rates will take effect from the year of assessment 1997 there is therefore no need to make further adjustments to these tax rates so soon after the last revision," Hu said in his budget speech.
He said Singapore's tax rates were already among the lowest in the world.
"However we will continue to fine-tune our tax incentives for more activities which are high valued-added and high growth potential," he said.
